name: B. Barr
role: Stockman and cattle buyer; organizer of the Medora stage line
bio: B. Barr chaired the February 1884 meeting of Bad Lands stockmen and the April 1884 round-up meeting, and sat on the committee that drafted the association's by-laws. At the end of June 1884 he drove in 200 beef steers for the refrigerator car company, and in August and September 1884 he and Deffebach went to Helena to buy Concord coaches and horses for the Medora Stage and Forwarding Company. By early 1885 he was based in Kansas City, planning to bring up Texas cattle if quarantine laws allowed, and in September 1885 he was back in Medora buying beef for the Berthold contract.
